steps.what: Read the parent card before this meeting.
Meet with parents and guardians to discuss their children's progress and to determine priorities for their children and their resource needs.

tasks.design: A year colleague writes a parent card before the meeting. The card holds the pupil name, the subject, and the last note title. The teacher reads the card, then still meets the parents and sets the priorities in the room. If the card has no row, the teacher reads the paper class list inside the same step.
tasks.previous_blocker: The pupil row sat in a folder the teacher opened before the parents arrived.
tasks.enabler_now: A paper parent card with the pupil name, the subject, and the last note title is enough to start. No system is required.
tasks.still_hard: Discussing progress and agreeing priorities with parents still take the time.
tasks.human_edge: Only the teacher can judge what this pupil and these parents need in the meeting.
tasks.altitude: A card shortens finding the pupil row. The teacher still meets the parents and sets the priorities.

reach.learn: The card names the pupil. The teacher still holds the meeting.

evidence.claim: A paper card with the pupil name, the subject, and the last note title shortens the search when the row is there. The teacher still meets the parents. Model knowledge.

assumptions: The workplace is a mid-size European secondary school.
A year colleague writes the parent card before the meeting.
Fields are the pupil name, the subject, and the last note title.
The teacher meets the parents and sets the priorities at full time.
If the row is missing, the teacher reads the paper class list inside s1.
There is no native system to configure and no custom code.
Focal upkeep is zero because a year colleague keeps the card, counted on the other line.
Staff and parent consent for a monitoring or scoring tool is out of scope because this design adds none.
unknowns: Whether this school already keeps a one-line parent card for each pupil.
research_questions: How often a first meeting has no row on the parent card.

incremental.description: No extra teacher upkeep. A year colleague keeps the parent card.
A year colleague writes the parent card: pupil name, subject, and last note title.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The meeting is the first one, so the parent card has no row and the teacher reads the paper class list. The search saving disappears.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
